aiProviders.title: AI Providers
aiProviders.description: Configure your AI model providers and API keys

empty.title: No providers configured
empty.desc: Add an AI provider to start using Clawy

dialog.desc: Configure a new AI model provider
dialog.apiKeyConfigured: An API key is already stored for this provider.
dialog.apiKeyMissing: No API key is stored for this provider yet.
dialog.apiKeyStored: Your API key is stored locally on your machine.
dialog.replaceApiKeyHelp: Leave this field empty if you want to keep the currently stored API key.
dialog.fallbackModelIdsHelp: One model ID per line. These models use the current provider config before falling back to other providers.
dialog.noFallbackOptions: Add another provider first to use it as a fallback target.

toast.minimaxConflict: Cannot add both MiniMax (Global) and MiniMax (CN) providers.

oauth.setupTokenPlaceholder: Paste the token generated by claude setup-token

oauth.setupTokenConfigured: A Claude setup-token is already saved for this provider.
oauth.setupTokenMissing: No Claude setup-token is saved for this provider yet.
oauth.replaceSetupTokenHelp: Leave this blank to keep the currently saved setup-token.

oauth.codexPrompt: Sign in with your OpenAI account to enable Codex OAuth.

oauth.step2: Open the login page in your browser.

gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.proxyDesc: Route Clawy backend and Gateway traffic through your local proxy client.
gateway.proxyServerHelp: The default proxy for all requests. Bare host:port values default to HTTP.
gateway.proxyHttpServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTP requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyHttpsServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTPS requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyAllServerHelp: Advanced fallback for SOCKS-capable clients and protocols such as Telegram. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyBypassHelp: Semicolon, comma, or newline separated hosts that should connect directly.
gateway.proxyRestartNote: Saving reapplies Clawy backend networking and restarts the Gateway immediately.

updates.title: Updates

status.check: Check for updates to get the latest features

updates.help: When auto-update is enabled, updates are downloaded and installed automatically.

nodeRuntime.title: Node.js Runtime
nodeRuntime.description: Expose Clawy's managed Node.js runtime to your terminal without changing where it is installed.
nodeRuntime.binDirDesc: Clawy exposes {{commands}} from this directory when you enable terminal access.
nodeRuntime.activationReady: The command shims are ready for future terminal sessions.
nodeRuntime.activationReadyRestart: The command shims are ready. Open a new terminal window to pick up the updated PATH.
nodeRuntime.activationPending: Clawy is currently using this runtime privately. Enable terminal access to expose it for your user account.
nodeRuntime.windowsNote: Windows updates the current user's PATH. Open a new terminal window after enabling to use node, npm, npx, and corepack.
nodeRuntime.posixNote: Clawy adds its bin directory to your shell profile. Open a new terminal window after enabling to use node, npm, npx, and corepack.

toast.loadFailed: Failed to load Node.js runtime status: {{error}}
toast.enabled: Node.js commands are now available from {{binDir}}.
toast.enabledRestart: Node.js commands are ready in {{binDir}}. Open a new terminal window to use them.

openclawRuntime.title: OpenClaw Runtime
openclawRuntime.description: Inspect and update the OpenClaw runtime independently from the Clawy shell.
openclawRuntime.restartNote: A successful OpenClaw runtime update restarts the Gateway automatically.
openclawRuntime.installNote: If Clawy is still using a bundled or workspace runtime, installing the update switches Clawy to the managed OpenClaw runtime.

fallback.title: Official update check failed
fallback.description: Clawy is showing the OSS fallback result for version detection. Installing still uses the official path first; if that fails, use the OSS resolve action.

toast.upToDate: OpenClaw is already up to date.
toast.installFailed: Failed to install the OpenClaw update: {{error}}

bridge.title: Clawy Bridge
bridge.description: Manage the address, LAN access policy, and token clients use to connect to this Clawy node.
bridge.listenHostDesc: Local mode listens on 127.0.0.1. LAN mode listens on 0.0.0.0.
bridge.publicBaseUrlDesc: Use this URL when another device or client connects to this node. Leave blank to derive it from the active listener.
bridge.trustedCidrsDesc: Optional. Leave blank to allow any private LAN address. Fill this to restrict access to specific IPs or CIDR ranges.
bridge.allowedOriginsDesc: Only browser-originated requests check Origin. Add any web app origins here if they connect directly to Bridge.
bridge.tokenDesc: Clients use this Bearer token when connecting to the current Clawy node.
bridge.restartNote: Regenerating the token restarts Clawy automatically so the new token takes effect immediately.
bridge.networkRestartNote: Saving network settings restarts Clawy automatically so the new listener and access policy take effect.
bridge.networkRestartHint: Local-only access remains the default. In LAN mode, Bridge still requires the Bearer token, and browser requests must also match the Origin allowlist.
bridge.envManagedHelp: This token comes from the CLAWY_BRIDGE_TOKEN environment variable and cannot be regenerated from the UI.
bridge.lanDesc: Allow trusted clients on the local network to reach this Clawy node.
bridge.localDesc: Only allow access from this machine.

dialog.title: Regenerate Bridge Token
dialog.message: Regenerating the token invalidates existing clients until they use the new token. Clawy will restart automatically to apply it.

networkDialog.title: Save Bridge Network Settings
networkDialog.message: Saving restarts Clawy so the new listen address, LAN access policy, and Origin allowlist can take effect.

toast.networkLoadFailed: Failed to load Bridge network config: {{error}}
toast.networkSaved: Bridge network settings saved. Clawy will restart now.
toast.networkSaveFailed: Failed to save Bridge network settings: {{error}}
toast.regenerated: Bridge token regenerated. Clawy will restart now.

developer.title: Developer
developer.consoleDesc: Access the native OpenClaw management interface
developer.consoleNote: Opens the Control UI with gateway token injected
developer.gatewayTokenDesc: Paste this into Control UI settings if prompted
developer.cliDesc: Copy a command to run OpenClaw without modifying PATH.
developer.installDetail: This will create ~/.local/bin/openclaw. Ensure ~/.local/bin is on your PATH if you want to run it globally.
